request.description: Redeems points and creates a coupon. Requires sufficient points. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key for retries. Clear collection variable loyaltyIdempotencyKey before starting a new redemption.
Available only when NODE_ENV=test. Add the signed VNPay IPN query parameters, including vnp_SecureHash, from the test gateway. An empty or invalid payload does not simulate a successful payment.
